item.title: Saloon Simulator
item.description:
Title: Saloon Simulator
Genre: Simulation
Developer: Glivi Games S.A.
Publisher: RockGame S.A.
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 15, 2025




About This Game

Start by running a saloon and carve your own place in the Wild West. Shape your bar, hire help, and get drawn into the lives and troubles of the people who gather around your counter. Out here, honest business is rarely enough. See what it takes to survive the frontier.

Run a working saloon from behind the counter. Mix drinks, cook meals, and keep supplies moving as the town slowly comes to life. It all starts as honest work, but never stays simple for long.

Shape the look of your saloon, clean up after long nights, and decide how much work you take on yourself. Hire staff to keep things running and turn the place into something the town recognizes as yours.

The Wild West rarely plays fair. Fights break out, bets are placed, and tempers flare. Survival often depends on how well you handle pressure and chaos. And you may bet, those two things are more than certain.

Cross the Line even further…

Sometimes, honest work is not enough. In Blueberry, opportunities appear in the gray areas of the frontier. What you choose to do when they surface is a different kind of business altogether.

Every face at the bar has a story. Get involved in the lives of Blueberry’s residents and watch personal tales unfold. Funny, tense, and sometimes dark. Your saloon is the hub for all good stories.

Core mechanics

  • Saloon customization - personalize your saloon with furniture sets, bar equipment, decorations, color tints, and functional upgrades.

  • Serve Food & Drinks - Prepare meals, mix drinks, and influence customer moods through hands-on bar mechanics.

  • Quest System - Meet unique characters with their own stories, ambitions, and problems that become part of your journey.

  • Criminal Opportunities - Explore the darker side of the Wild West and choose how far you are willing to go.

  • Saloon & Business Management - Expand with gambling tables, rooms for rent, staff hiring, and side ventures.

  • Reputation System - Earn trust, unlock rewards, and watch the town react to your growing influence.

  • Frontier Activities - Encounter side mechanics and unexpected moments that capture the spirit of the Old West.

    • Additional Notes: Requirements for 1920x1080 resolution. Integrated Graphic Cards are not supported. Intel ARC series may not be supported yet. SSD required.
    Recommended:

    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX2070 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700XT 8GB
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Requirements for 1920x1080 resolution. Integrated Graphic Cards are not supported. Intel ARC series may not be supported yet. SSD required.

item.title: It's About Pirates
item.description:
Title: It's About Pirates
Genre: Action
Developer: Elderwoof Games
Publisher: Elderwoof Games
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026




About This Game

It’s About Pirates is a survivors-like where you blast through relentless waves of enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your ship for epic naval battles. Navigate through storms of cannonballs, face mythical sea monsters, and time your attacks for devastating impact.

Transform your ship into an unstoppable fortress with flamethrowers, harpoons, mortars, and a vast arsenal of deadly upgrades. Strategically combine weapons and items to craft powerful builds. Be prepared, as increasingly challenging enemies will stand in your way.

Customize your vessel with over 150 unique parts discovered throughout your adventures. Complete quests across different pirate realms to expand your collection of ship components.

Features:

  • ⚔️ Automatic or manual aiming

  • 🧭 Sail through 30 adventures

  • ⚓ 10 distinct captains

  • 🏴‍☠️ 6 Factions with unique abilities

  • 🗡️ Over 140 items to shape your build

  • 💰 Collect loot and unlock new ship skins

  • ☠️ Test your skill in Endless mode

  • 🏆 Compete on the leaderboard and claim your place among the top pirates

The sea awaits!

item.title: Find The Needle
item.description:
Title: Find The Needle
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Needless Games
Publisher: Needless Games
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 6, 2026




About This Game

You were a farmer.
At least, you think you were.
Now you're stuck inside a strange warehouse, standing in front of an endless haystack. You don't remember how you got here, who brought you here, or why the doors won't open.
There is only one instruction:
Find the needles.

There are some in the pile. You start by hand, with a metal detector. You end up with belts, balers, scanners and robotic arms doing the looking for you. Place real machines, wire the power, feed them by belt. Sell the hay, buy more machines, get given a bigger pile.

Nobody has said what happens when you finish.

The pile

Begin By Hand

The tools

Buy tools like shovels, buckets, wheelbarrows, pitchforks, vacuums. Anything that helps you process hay manually!

Start Automating

Automate everything! Build robots, drones, conveyor belts, hay wrappers, paper machines, sorting machines, and advanced systems that process hay and search for needles while you focus on expanding your factory.

Hay products

Turn ordinary hay into valuable products! Process it into hay pulp, compressed bales, eco bricks, hay paper, pellets, and much more. Build new production lines, unlock advanced machinery, and find better ways to turn your mountain of hay into profit.

Tech tree

Progress through a huge tech tree with over 300 upgrades! Unlock new machines, improve production speed, increase efficiency, expand your factory, and discover entirely new ways to process hay.

What happens when you collect all the needles?

- Who knows?

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Find The Needle has optional rude emotes: the middle finger and other rude hand signs, spitting, a crude sexual hand gesture and a peeing emote. They are switched off by default when you start and only appear after you turn on Rude Emotes in the You tab. Your character can also fall from a great height and flop over like a rag doll, with no blood.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: 4 cores / 8 threads, Intel i5-8400 or Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: dedicated GPU with Vulkan 1.3 support and 4 GB VRAM, GTX 1050 Ti or RX 570
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Integrated graphics are not supported and may crash
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: 6+ cores, Ryzen 5 5600 or Intel i5-12400
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super, RTX 2060 with 6 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Very large factories are CPU heavy. A faster CPU keeps the frame rate up late in the game

item.title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
item.description:
Title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
Genre: RPG
Developer: Stormfront Studios
Publisher: SNEG
Franchise: Dungeons & Dragons
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026




About This Game

Malevolence is afoot in the Forgotten Realms world: a new Pool of Radiance has been discovered beneath the city of New Phlan, and a wave of pure evil now emanates from it, cursing all it touches. Answer Elminster’s call, descend into the ruined Elven city of Myth Drannor and stop the sorceress and the dracolich before they turn the power of the Pool against the realm.

Create up to four heroes and recruit two more along the way, for a party of six. The game features the Dungeons & Dragons rules, with different races, classes and spells. Players may choose between the genuine turn-based style of role-playing and a more action-focused, timed-turn style of play. The optional turn timer makes for more engaging, higher-pressure fights.

Originally released in 2001, Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor revived one of the most storied names in cRPG history. Now it’s available digitally for the first time, with a full suite of enhancements. The re-release runs smoothly on modern hardware, includes sharper visuals, fixes numerous original game bugs and adds widescreen support, including 4K.

The improved UI adds an action bar and tooltips. It comes with full controller support and reworked camera control.

  • Return to the legendary Pool of Radiance - back to where the legacy began

  • Save Faerûn: answer Elminster’s call and stop the sorceress and the dracolich from using the power of the Pool of Radiance against the realm

  • Party of six: create up to four heroes and recruit two more along the way

  • Deep progression: level up characters to 16th level and cast 8th-level spells

  • Includes over 90 spells

  • Tactical turn-based combat and classic dungeon crawling for anyone hungry for more Dungeons & Dragons gameplay

  • Optional turn timer for more engaging, higher-pressure fights

  • Runs smoothly on modern hardware

  • Fixed numerous original game bugs

  • Widescreen support, including 4K

  • Sharper visuals

  • Improved UI with the addition of the action bar and tooltips

  • Adjustable combat animation speed

  • Optional "Legacy" mode that preserves original gameplay and visuals

  • Full controller support

  • Reworked camera control

  • Customize the scope of the enhancements with the in-game settings

  • Other Quality of Life improvements

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a game developed in 2001. According to official ratings from that time, it contains violence and blood. Might not be appropriate for all audiences.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11
    • Processor: 1.8 GHz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c Compatible Graphics Card
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: Piano Glow
item.description:
Title: Piano Glow
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Animation & Modeling , Audio Production , Video Production
Developer: TheAlanski
Publisher: TheAlanski
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Mar 10, 2025




About This Game

PianoGlow, created by pianists, features:

Multiplayer

  • Show-off your piano skills & listen to others around the world.

  • Queue-based mode to take turns playing piano.

  • Several multiplayer modes, including queue, Mania (4K/7K), guess drawing (draw while playing piano), guess songs (players play a song and guess each other's song).

  • Global and private chatrooms. Voice chat and friend/block lists.

  • Offline and single-player mode.

Any keyboard: QWERTY computer/laptop, digital piano, any MIDI device or acoustic piano

  • Play any music or song with a QWERTY keyboard (laptop/computer).

  • Or connect to a real digital piano or MIDI controller via Bluetooth or USB-B.

  • Any song works with any size keyboard, even as small as 25, since the PianoGlow app can auto-convert any song or MIDI to a smaller one.

  • Velocity integration with Wooting Analog QWERTY keyboards so that you can play with dynamics on the computer keyboard (loud & soft).

  • Record & load MIDI files (live play or render as video from within the app).

  • Any songs can be converted to computer key controls, where each computer key corresponds to a note on the piano.

Training modes & tools

  • Unlimited use of AI converter tools, converting any piano video, PDF or audio into tutorials (MIDI files, falling notes).

  • Ear training, rhythm, falling notes, chord, scales, arpeggios & sheet music game modes. Perfect for all levels (including beginners with no experience).

  • Customizable setting in many training modes to auto-pause until you hit the next correct note/chord (auto-pause on by default).

  • Tracks stats and shows wrong answers more often to focus on your weaknesses. Unlock achievements!

  • Detailed calendar that shows exactly how much you practiced each day and month.

  • AI-based fingering, help determine which fingers to use on any MIDI file or song.

  • AI-based converter that adjusts any MIDI/MusicXML or song to fit into a smaller piano/keyboard.

  • Interactive Circle-of-Fifths cheat sheet - clicking shows the common chord triads, key signature and the 7th chords.

  • Automated Chord Name Identifier & Intervals when you play any chord on the piano.

  • Lighted Keyboards - lights up the indicators on your MIDI keyboard in falling notes.

  • Upload any MIDI or MusicXML file to practice music with, and it will show both Falling Notes and Sheet Music notation.

  • Set any custom time-range and loop practice it. It will remember the time-range for when you re-visit the song.

  • MIDI Editor - create new songs and edit your performances/recordings.

  • MIDI Loop - loop your playing and layer in different SoundFonts.

Customizable themes

  • 3D piano + 3D virtual hands that emulate playing, includes various 3D venues and 3D characters that can play.

  • Automatic cinematic camera movements, including POV camera to emulate POV playing.

  • 3D cats that sleep and walk around.

  • Stunning visuals & particle effects that move in sync with the tempo of your playing.

  • Upload video files as the background.

  • 3D sheet music visualization with glowing orbs and 3D lighting effects.

QWERTY features

  • Auto-play QWERTY sheet music (semi-auto included).

  • Typing game modes, where falling notes (and sheet music based notation) are also shown with QWERTY notes.

  • Velocity settings such as predictive or random velocity, adjust velocity curve and more.

  • Transpose detection - press TAB to auto-transpose to the next auto-detected transpose in QWERTY sheets, or hold transpose and press a number to manually jump to a specific transpose.

  • In-game notepad for you to load or edit QWERTY sheets, with transpose tools and OCR.

  • Convert MIDI files to QWERTY.

Customizable Audio

  • Customizable reverb & equalizer audio effects.

  • Upload custom SoundFont (.sf2, .sf3) files, VST3 support and ASIO support.

  • Load multiple SoundFonts simultaneously (e.g. one for left-hand vs right-hand).

  • Create your own SoundFonts (by loading an MP3 or WAV and it will let you export a SoundFont file)!

Community

  • Discord community server, chat and share tips about piano.

  • Dedicated website and regular social media content.

  • Pay once and it's for a lifetime: all updates in the future will be included free as part of your one-time purchase (instead of DLCs), with a heavy focus on user-feedback as seen on the news. No hidden costs.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some 2D assets & UI are created with the assistance of AI.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and Windows 10
    • Processor: 1.7 GHz Dual Core CPU
    • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Recommend at least a dedicated GPU
    • Storage: 800 MB available space
    • Sound Card: Any
* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: macOS 13 or later
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent (Apple M1 or later for Apple Silicon Macs)
    • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
    • Storage: 800 MB available space

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: If you can run other Steam games and installed Steam via the official deb package, should likely be fine
    • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
    • Storage: 1100 MB available space
